title: Approved consequence-class profile C*
description: Manuscript Section VII-A. C* is a governance object versioned with M. Each classification records the approving authority, rationale, materiality boundary, effective date, and any authorized emergency-override procedure. Contraction within an active assessment is a trigger event requiring re-approval.

materiality_order.description: Ascending order of materiality. Membership of C* requires the descriptor's materiality to be at or above the rule's minimum.

required_reversibility.description: Schema v1.1, Section VII-A. When present, membership additionally requires the descriptor's reversibility to be one of these values -- e.g. physical_harm_to_person is reversibility-qualified over {irreversible, requires_intervention}, so a self-limiting reversible harm does not enter C* on its class alone. Absent (the v1.0 default for every existing profile) means no reversibility qualification, identical to pre-v1.1 behavior.
